name: SueDataCenters.org Data Center Registry
attribution: Facility data from Compute Atlas (E. Kubiak) v1.32.0, CC BY 4.0, with case reporting and additional records by SueDataCenters.org. Cite both.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Stable identifier. Matches the Compute Atlas facility id where the record came from the survey.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Facility or campus name as it appears in the public record.

fields.name: operator
fields.description: Operator or developer named in the record.

fields.name: company
fields.description: Our company page slug where the operator maps to one, else blank.

fields.name: facility_type
fields.description: data_center or crypto_mining.

fields.name: status
fields.description: proposed, permitted, under_construction, operational, or cancelled.

fields.name: community_reception
fields.description: supported, mixed, contested, opposed, litigation, or blank where no reception is on record.

fields.name: source_confidence
fields.description: confirmed, reported, or rumored, per the survey's definitions.

fields.name: state
fields.description: Two letter postal code.

fields.name: latitude
fields.description: Decimal degrees. See coordinate_precision.

fields.name: coordinate_precision
fields.description: exact, approximate (city or county centroid), or blank.

fields.name: capacity_mw_planned
fields.description: Planned or announced capacity in megawatts.

fields.name: capacity_mw_operational
fields.description: Operating capacity in megawatts.

fields.name: investment_usd
fields.description: Announced investment in US dollars.

fields.name: jobs_permanent
fields.description: Permanent jobs promised in the record.

fields.name: water_reported_mgd
fields.description: Reported water use in million gallons per day.

fields.name: utility
fields.description: Serving electric utility named in the record.

fields.name: subsidy_programs
fields.description: Number of public subsidy programs on record.

fields.name: subsidy_usd_known
fields.description: Sum of subsidy amounts where an amount is on record.

fields.name: record_updated
fields.description: Date the record was last changed.

fields.name: source_count
fields.description: Number of cited sources.

fields.name: record_origin
fields.description: compute-atlas or suedatacenters.

fields.name: case_files
fields.description: URLs of our case files about this site, separated by a space.

fields.name: profile_url
fields.description: The profile page, present where the record clears our publishing threshold.
